vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: trongrid-transaction-info
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle provides legitimate instructions for an AI agent to query and decode TRON blockchain transactions using the TronGrid MCP server. It outlines a structured workflow for fetching transaction details, checking confirmation status, and parsing smart contract events without any evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions, required calls, and lack of installs/credentials are coherent with its stated purpose of querying and decoding TRON transactions.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the runtime instructions: all recommended calls (getTransactionById, getTransactionInfoById, solidityGetTransactionById, getContract, getEventsByTransactionId, getInternalTransactionsByTxId, getNowBlock, etc.) are directly related to querying and decoding TRON transactions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines itself to TRON/TronGrid MCP API calls and decoding logic. It does not instruct reading arbitrary files, accessing unrelated environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints outside the TRON MCP scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files; nothing is written to disk and no third-party packages are fetched.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials, which is reasonable for a read-only transaction decoder; however, some TronGrid deployments or rate-limited MCP endpoints may require API keys or node access in practice—the skill does not document that requirement or where credentials would come from.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, model invocation is enabled (platform default). The skill does not request persistent system-wide configuration or access to other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and limited to querying TronGrid MCP endpoints and decoding results. Before installing, consider: (1) provenance — the package has no listed homepage or source owner information, so prefer skills from known maintainers when possible; (2) network access — the skill relies on access to TronGrid/solidity nodes and in some environments you may need an API key or node credentials (the skill doesn't request or document these); and (3) secrets — never provide private keys or wallet seed phrases to any skill (this skill doesn't ask for them). If you need stricter assurance, ask the publisher for a source repo or documentation that shows which endpoint/credentials (if any) are required.
